document.title: [Title Excised] A Fatwa Issued by Usama Bin Ladin's Islamic Army Which Allowed for Attacks Against the U.S. Military in Saudi Arabia
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA Intelligence Report on a fatwa issued by the Islamic Army allowing attacks on the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 2, Endnote 47.

events.description: Fatwa issued by Bin Ladin's Islamic Army allowing attacks against the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia, as reported in a CIA cable dated 8 January 1997.
Report dated 8 January 1997 on a fatwa issued by Bin Ladin's Islamic Army that allowed attacks against the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia. The fatwa's own date is not given.
The title refers to travel by Islamic Army members (the text is garbled) from Saudi Arabia to Iran for explosives training.

relationships.detail: The cable calls it 'Bin Ladin's Islamic Army'.
relationships.quote: BIN LADIN 'S ISLAMIC ARMY WHICH ALLOWED FOR ATTACKS AGAINST THE U.S. MILITARY IN SAUDI ARABIA

relationships.detail: The Islamic Army's fatwa permits attacks against the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia.
relationships.quote: ALLOWED FOR ATTACKS AGAINST THE U.S. MILITARY IN SAUDI ARABIA

relationships.detail: The report calls the group 'Bin Ladin's Islamic Army', which implies his leadership or ownership of it.
The Islamic Army issued a fatwa that permitted attacks on the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia.
relationships.quote: FATWA ISSUED ... ISLAMIC ARMY WHICH ALLOWED FOR ATTACKS AGAINST THE U.S. MILITARY IN SAUDI ARABIA

relationships.detail: The Islamic Army is described as planning an operation in Saudi Arabia in light of the fatwa.
relationships.quote: ISLAMIC ARMY'S PLANS FOR OPERATION IN SAUDI ARABIA IN LIGHT OF THE FATWA

relationships.detail: The garbled title suggests that people went from Saudi Arabia to Iran for explosives training. The text is fragmentary and the link is only inferred.
relationships.quote: SAUDI ARABIA TO IRAN FOR EXPLOSIVES TRA

key_claims: A January 1997 CIA cable reports that Bin Ladin's Islamic Army issued a fatwa permitting attacks on the U.S. military in Saudi Arabia.
The cable also refers to the Islamic Army's plans for operations in Saudi Arabia in light of the fatwa.
The garbled header suggests a link between Saudi Arabia, Iran and explosives, but the text is too corrupted to establish details.
